dct_description_sm: This GIS dataset depicts the surficial geology of the Hamburg Area (NTS 84E/SW) (discontinuous permafrost features). The data were created in geodatabase format and output for public distribution in shapefile format. These data comprise the permafrost polygon features of Alberta Geological Survey Map 565, Surficial Geology of the Hamburg Area (NTS 84E/SW).
dct_title_s: Surficial Geology of the Hamburg Area (NTS 84E/SW) (GIS data, permafrost polygon features)
